description: Soft, slow fibreglass from the back of Dad's closet. It forgives a lazy stroke, but it won't throw a long line or stop a big fish.
The all-round trout rod. Throws dries and nymphs to the far seam with an honest, steady stroke.
A stiff rod for heavy flies and heavy fish. It throws a mile of line if your timing is crisp, and it punishes sloppy strokes.
